headline: No votes taken due to lack of quorum; discussed MPD statements on Flock Cameras and Immigration Enforcement.
summary: The meeting lacked a quorum, so no items could be voted on and January's minutes could not be approved. Members and residents heard from MPD Detective Mulcahy and Lieutenant Powell about Flock camera use and data sharing, and about MPD's limits when interacting with ICE. Q&A documents were created for both topics.
